plain.li: [body:bird] Hold still, feathers, I'm nearly done.
[body:bird] Don't peck, I'm on your side.
[body:bird] Look at you, all fluffed up and cross.
[body:bird,job:feed] Plenty here, no need to peck at each other.
[body:bird,job:tend] Let me see that wing, gently now.
[body:bird,job:tame] Come on, little bird, I've got seed.
[body:bird,job:train] Again, and this time stay on the perch.
[body:bird,job:rope] In you go, and stop flapping at me.
[body:bird,young] You're all fluff and no feathers yet.
[body:bird,oldanimal] Ragged old thing, you've earned your quiet corner.
[body:bird,winter] Feathers puffed up against the cold, I don't blame you.
[body:bird] Shoo, not on my boots, please.
[body:bird] You've a beady eye on my pocket, haven't you?
[body:bird,rain] Wet feathers, poor thing, nearly done.
[body:bird,named] Come here, {PET_nameDef}, let me look at you.
[body:other] I never know what you're thinking, and I suspect you don't either.
[body:other] You're a strange sort of creature, but you're ours.
[body:other] Easy, I'm not going to hurt you.
[body:other,job:feed] Here you are, eat up, whatever you like best.
[body:other,job:tend] Hold still for me, nearly done.
[body:other,job:tame] Slowly, you and me, no sudden moves.
[body:other,job:train] I've no idea if this is sinking in, but let's go again.
[body:other,young] You're very small for something so strange.
[body:other,winter] You don't like the cold any more than I do, do you?
[body:other] Whatever you are, you're a good one.
[body:other] Steady, I'll be quick about this.
[body:other,named] There you are, {PET_nameDef}, odd as ever.
[body:other,oldanimal] Old and slow, the pair of us, aren't we?

warm.li: [body:other] You're a funny little thing, and I'm fond of you.

cheerful.li: [body:bird] Who's the prettiest bird in the colony, then?
[body:other] Nobody else here has a friend quite like you.

gloomy.li: [body:bird] Even the birds look tired today.
[body:other] I don't understand you, but then I don't understand most things.

plain.li: [body:bird] Hopping after me again, are you?
[body:bird] Mind my feet, little one.
[body:bird] You'd follow me to the ends of the colony, wouldn't you?
[body:other] Still behind me, are you, {PET_nameDef}?
[body:other] You're a slow shadow, but a faithful one.
[body:other] Come along, then, at your own pace.
[first] We've given the herd's leader a name: {PET_nameDef}. It was leading them long before we noticed.
[first,body:beast] {PET_nameDef} goes first to the water and the rest follow. The herd's leader, then, and named for it today.
[first,body:bird] Where {PET_nameDef} scratches, the others scratch. The flock has a leader, and now it has a name.
[first,body:other] The others keep close to {PET_nameDef}. I can't say how they decided, but they have, and so have we.
[line] {PET_nameDef} leads now, of the old leader's blood. The herd took to it as if they'd known all along.
[line,body:bird] {PET_nameDef}, the old leader's own, leads the flock now. Same strut, same temper.
[new] A new leader for the herd, {PET_nameDef}, and none of the old leader's blood in it. A fresh start.
[new,body:beast] {PET_nameDef} leads the herd now. The others will get used to it, and so will I.

gloomy.li: A new leader for the herd. They move on quicker than we do.

cold.li: {PET_nameDef} leads the herd now. I'll note which ones follow it closest.

plain.li: [body:bird] You're in charge of this lot now, feathers.
[body:bird,line] Just like the old leader, you strut the same.
[body:other] They follow you, so I suppose I'd better listen too.
[body:other,new] New leader, new ways, I expect.
[body:beast] {PET_nameDef} lies down more than it stands now. I'll sit with it at the pens this evening.
[body:beast] {PET_nameDef}'s step has gone short and it's last to the trough now. The old leader's last season, I think.
[body:bird] {PET_nameDef} hardly leaves the roost now. I'll sit with it a while this evening.
[body:bird] {PET_nameDef}'s feathers have thinned and its call has gone hoarse. Not long now, I think.
[body:other] {PET_nameDef} hardly moves now. I'll sit with it this evening.
[body:other] {PET_nameDef} is slower every day. I don't know its kind's years, but I know this look.

blunt.li: {PET_nameDef}'s old. Sitting with it tonight. Might not be many more.

cheerful.li: {PET_nameDef} is old and slow and still the boss of the lot. I'll sit with the old thing this evening.

cold.li: {PET_nameDef} is near the end of its years. I'll see to it this evening, and look at who follows it after.

plain.li: [body:beast] {PET_nameDef} is gone. The pens look wrong without it, and I keep counting heads.
[body:bird] {PET_nameDef} is gone. I keep listening for its call over the others'.
[body:other] {PET_nameDef} is gone. Whatever passes for grief in its kind, I've enough for all of them.
[body:beast] We lost {PET_nameDef} today. It led the herd longer than some of us have lived here.
[body:beast] {PET_nameDef} is dead, the old {KIND}. The herd will choose again. I'm not ready to.
[body:bird] {PET_nameDef} is dead, the old {KIND} the flock followed. The roost has a gap in it.
[body:other] We lost {PET_nameDef}, the old {KIND}. The others will find their way. I'll miss it more than I expected.
The herd's leader is dead. {PET_nameDef}. Whoever leads them next, it won't be quite the same herd.

cheerful.li: Goodbye, {PET_nameDef}. You led them well and bossed us all. The pens will be dull for a while.

gloomy.li: {PET_nameDef} is gone. I knew it was coming, and it didn't help.

cold.li: {PET_nameDef} has died. The herd will settle on a new leader within days.

plain.li: [born] {PET_nameDef}, born today to {OTHER_nameDef}, the first of the year. I mean to go down and see it the moment I'm free.
[hatched] The first egg of the year has hatched: {PET_nameDef}, {OTHER_nameDef}'s. I'll go and look at it when the work lets me.
[born,body:beast] {OTHER_nameDef} has a young one at her side, {PET_nameDef}, the first of the year. I'll be at the pens before the day's out.
[born] A first young one for the year: {PET_nameDef}. I keep finding reasons to look towards the pens.
[born] {PET_nameDef} is born, {OTHER_nameDef}'s, and the year's started properly. I'll go and see it later.
[hatched] {PET_nameDef} is out of the shell, the first of the year. I'll go and look at the little thing when I can.
[hatched] The first hatchling of the year, {PET_nameDef}. I'll be down to see it before the day's done.
New life in the herd, the first of the year: {PET_nameDef}. The work can spare me a while later.

warm.li: The first of the year, {PET_nameDef}. I'll go down to the pens later and sit with the pair of them a while.

blunt.li: First young of the year. {PET_nameDef}. Going to look later.

gloomy.li: The first of the year, {PET_nameDef}. Something new and alive. I'll go and see it, for the good of my heart.

cold.li: The first young of the year in the herd: {PET_nameDef}. I'll look it over later today.
